away.name: Arturs Silovs
away.news: Silovs has had an up-and-down start to the 2026-27 season, challenged by backup Sergei Murashov, but he hopes to build on his most recent performance, saving 24 shots (.960 SV%) in a 2-1 shootout win over the Dallas Stars. The 25-year-old Latvian goalie has a 2.72 GAA and .885 SV% in four games this season (3-1-0). The Penguins enter Friday's action as +181 road underdogs against a Colorado Avalanche team that has lost three of its last five games (2-2-1).

home.name: Mackenzie Blackwood
home.news: Colorado Head Coach Jared Bednar has favoured Mackenzie Blackwood early in the 2026-27 season despite some up-and-down outings. That said, the 29-year-old goalie was solid in his most recent outing, saving 24 of 26 shots (.923 SV%) in a 3-2 win over the Dallas Stars. He has a 3.04 GAA and .879 SV% in five games this season (3-2-0). Colorado enters Friday's contest as sizeable -201 home favourites against a 3-3-1 Pittsburgh Penguins team.

home.name: Lukas Dostal
home.news: Dostal has played five of six games for the Ducks this season and will return to the crease on Friday against the Boston Bruins. The 26-year-old Czech goalie was solid in his most recent outing, saving 32 of 35 shots (.914 SV%), but came up short in a 4-2 loss to the Calgary Flames. He has a 2.98 GAA and .892 SV% in five games (3-2-0). The Ducks enter Friday's contest as slight +101 home underdogs against a Bruins team that has outscored opponents 17-5 during a three-game winning streak.
